prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
blank_sentence: By 2018, most of the city's restaurant owners spoke of the firm as their trade's ______.

worlds.passage: In 2015 a small software firm began working with independent restaurants in one mid-sized city. Its app took diners' orders, passed them on to kitchens and couriers, and kept a fifth of every bill, a service national companies had offered there for years. The app listed every kitchen alphabetically, and when an order went wrong, the firm simply forwarded the complaint to the restaurant. By 2018, most of the city's restaurant owners spoke of the firm as their trade's ______.
worlds.explanation: The firm stood between diners and kitchens, passing orders along and keeping a share of each bill, so owners saw it as their trade's "middleman." "Pioneer" fails because national companies had offered the same service for years. "Publicist" fails because it promoted no kitchen, listing them alphabetically, and "referee" fails because it settled no disputes, only forwarding complaints.

pioneer.why: others had done the same thing long before, so the firm was not first

publicist.why: an alphabetical list promotes no restaurant

referee.quote: forwarded the complaint to the restaurant
referee.why: the firm passed disputes on rather than deciding them

worlds.passage: In 2015 a small software firm began working with independent restaurants in one mid-sized city. Its software let each restaurant take reservations on its own website, something no company had offered anywhere before, and within three years every national booking service had copied it. Diners still dealt with restaurants directly, and when a booking went wrong, the firm simply forwarded the complaint to the restaurant. By 2018, most of the city's restaurant owners spoke of the firm as their trade's ______.
worlds.explanation: The firm offered something no company had offered before, and the national services later copied it, so owners saw it as their trade's "pioneer." "Middleman" fails because diners dealt with restaurants directly through the restaurants' own websites. "Publicist" fails because nothing indicates the firm promoted any restaurant, and "referee" fails because it forwarded complaints rather than deciding them.

middleman.why: the firm did not stand between diners and restaurants

publicist.quote: take reservations on its own website
publicist.why: the firm supplied a booking tool, not promotion of any restaurant

referee.quote: forwarded the complaint to the restaurant
referee.why: the firm passed disputes on rather than deciding them
